apps.name: CONTINUUM
apps.subtitle: Work, life, and a little chaos.
apps.localizedDescription: A cloud-connected native space for work, life, and creative ideas. Sign in with the same email on iPhone and the private Continuity website. Explicitly import selected non-sensitive reference snapshots on the website; Quick Calibrate and Deep Dive select source-grounded questions on the server. Edit, skip, review, and propose corrections without changing authoritative records. Spark uses a secure AI gateway with consent, history, and favorites. Unsigned for Feather; iOS 16.4 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: Cloud-connected release with source-grounded Calibrate, adaptive Deep Dive, answer review and AI Spark. Fixes cloud-aware home counts and AI help. Live website sign-in, authorized context import, cloud answer persistence, real AI generation, favorites and idempotent pending proposals verified. 43 root tests, 21 native tests, TypeScript and macOS device archive passed. Physical iPhone acceptance remains pending.

Cloud auth and sync; explicit scoped context import on the private website; source-grounded server Calibrate and adaptive Deep Dive; reviewable targeted proposals; AI Spark and favorites. 43 root tests, 21 native tests, TypeScript and macOS Release device build passed. Physical iPhone acceptance is pending. Rule-based question selection; no automatic access to private website sessions.

First native iOS preview: five screens, persistent Quick Calibrate drafts, adaptive follow-ups, review/edit/skip, and Spark history/favorites. 19 native tests, 31 existing tests, TypeScript, Expo Doctor, Release device/simulator builds, and two iOS simulator flows passed. Physical iPhone installation, signing, haptics, and VoiceOver remain untested. No live Continuity or AI connection.

apps.name: Sample Size
apps.subtitle: References and decisions for your clothing brand.
apps.localizedDescription: Clothing-brand research and review with Grailed and Depop listing search, full photo galleries and followed searches. Authenticated Brand Review site sync for design ratings, feedback and decisions. Followed marketplace searches refresh every six hours while active or on return; provider availability and limits apply. Collections, image notes, casting boards and discovery taste remain local. Tag-based ranking, not visual AI training. Unsigned for Feather; iOS 16.4 or later.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds real Grailed/Depop search through the private site connection, full listing photo galleries, saved searches in Discover, six-hour foreground/return refresh, cached fallback and daily provider limits. Built-in discovery refreshes while active. 41 app tests, 10 server tests, route cache/auth/failure checks and 9 release tests passed; live marketplace search/detail responses and phone-width UI verified. Physical iPhone sign-in/runtime untested. No closed-app background refresh or visual AI learning.

Adds authenticated design-review sync with your existing Brand Review site, current designs/reference photo downloads, revision conflicts and retry protection. Fixes overflowing buttons, photo controls and narrow-screen layouts. 38 app tests, 7 sync tests, 9 release tests and browser layout checks passed; unsigned arm64 IPA and 142 bundled images/fonts verified. Physical iPhone sign-in/runtime not tested. Collections, image notes, casting boards, reference uploads, discussions and discovery taste remain local.

Image-first navigation, photo galleries and zoom, five verified public catalogs, add/pause sources, named collections, exact-image Keep/Change notes, graphic scoring, revision comparison, recovered drafts and complete file backups. 34 app tests, mobile browser checks and unsigned arm64 IPA verification passed. Native iPhone runtime untested. Live site/Dot sync, marketplace integrations and visual-model learning remain pending.

Focused review sessions, Rework with reasons, weighted criteria, threaded local notes, reversible decision history, brand filters, multi-file reference/casting boards and an in-app arrival inbox. 27 app tests and mobile browser checks passed; native IPA archive verified. Physical iPhone runtime remains untested. Local-only data; export JSON omits attachment bytes.

New black/silver editorial UI and official-store discoveries. Daily feed refresh, manual refresh, retained saved discoveries and separate Original archive. Browser QA passed17 checks; native IPA integrity verified. iPhone installation/runtime still needs device testing.
First unsigned preview. Offline clothing references, taste lanes, collections, reviews, and export. Not yet tested on an iPhone.
